### (a) Three social posts

1. We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, every person on Earth will become wealthier than the richest 1% are today. Not just a fortunate few. Everyone.

2. We see a future where extraordinary wealth belongs to everyone. If we build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years, every person on Earth will become wealthier than today’s richest 1%. That is the future we stand for.

3. We reject the idea that immense wealth must remain the privilege of a few. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, every person on Earth will become wealthier than the richest 1% are now. We stand for that shared abundance.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, every person on Earth will become wealthier than the richest 1% are now. We mean everyone: every family, every community, every country. We see this as a transformation in what humanity can create, provide and enjoy—not merely another wave of profits for those already at the top. We stand for a future in which extraordinary prosperity is ordinary, and material deprivation belongs to the past. We embrace that future with conviction. Our ambition is not to spread scarcity more evenly, but to move beyond it into abundance shared by all.
